cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lead a request to keep the pottery room open late. Join me so it looks like a users' proposal, not a favor for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I leave at five. Late opening does nothing for my class.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me what your class needs. I can lead a broader proposal; I want you beside me when we present it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Weekend access. Two of the morning students would come if that's included.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Include it. You and those two can explain weekends first; I'll follow with evenings. We'll present as the room users, and I'll fit the request around all our classes.
